types.name: str
types.note: null-terminated C string; slice representation in Tier 2

types.name: arr
types.note: fixed-size; element type tracked, size inferred from literal

types.name: &T
types.note: Tier 1 restricts pointee to 'int' until Tier 2 slice work

error_codes.name: InvalidIdentifier
error_codes.hint: identifiers must start with a letter or '_'

error_codes.name: InvalidToken
error_codes.hint: check for stray characters or unterminated literals

error_codes.name: UndeclaredVariable
error_codes.hint: make sure the variable is declared before use

error_codes.name: UndeclaredFunction
error_codes.hint: functions must be declared before they are called

error_codes.name: TypeMismatch
error_codes.hint: Eris does not insert implicit conversions; the types must match exactly

error_codes.name: VariableAlreadyDeclared
error_codes.hint: a name can only be bound once in the same scope

error_codes.name: AssignmentToImmutable
error_codes.hint: declare the variable with 'mut' to allow reassignment

error_codes.name: BreakOutsideLoop
error_codes.hint: break is only valid inside a loop body

error_codes.name: ContinueOutsideLoop
error_codes.hint: continue is only valid inside a loop body

error_codes.name: MissingReturn
error_codes.hint: non-void functions must return on every control-flow path

error_codes.name: ReturnMissingValue
error_codes.hint: supply a return value, or change the function's return type

error_codes.name: NonIterableInForLoop
error_codes.hint: use 'start..end' to iterate an integer range

error_codes.name: IndexOutOfRange
error_codes.hint: indices must lie in 0..array_size

error_codes.name: IndexNotInteger
error_codes.hint: convert the index expression to 'int' before indexing

error_codes.name: TakeRefOfNonLvalue
error_codes.hint: introduce a named variable first, then take a reference to it

error_codes.name: TakeMutRefOfImmutable
error_codes.hint: declare the variable with 'mut' to allow mutable references

error_codes.name: DerefOfNonReference
error_codes.hint: take a reference with '&' or '&mut' before dereferencing

error_codes.name: ReturnsLocalReference
error_codes.hint: return the value itself, or pass the destination as a '&mut' parameter

error_codes.name: UnsupportedOperandType
error_codes.hint: arithmetic operators require 'int' or 'float' operands; comparison operators additionally accept 'char' and 'bool'

error_codes.name: DiscordDependency
error_codes.hint: each statement in a discord block must neither read nor write anything another statement in the block writes

error_codes.name: DiscordImpurity
error_codes.hint: only variable declarations, assignments, and pure expressions (no calls except 'len', no references, no control flow, no side effects) are allowed inside a discord block
